g.text: records, corridor talk, phones, screens, handovers, social media, family enquiries (\"is she here?\" → confirm identity + consent first)
deceased keep confidentiality too (disclose to executors/coroner/public-health only per law) • adolescents: Gillick-competent privacy with
safeguarding limits stated • HIV/STI/mental-health/abortion: extra stigma = extra locks, never ward gossip
test: would the patient expect this person to know? No → silence.
🟡 SHARE — for direct care, minimum necessary
treating team (handover, referrals, results) • consent implied for care, explicit for teaching/research/photos
patient access: records shown + explained on request (Data Protection Act 2012) • audit/quality: de-identified where possible
relatives: ONLY with consent or best-interests incapacity (document who + why) • interpreters bound + briefed
test: is this person IN the care, and is this detail NEEDED? Both yes → share.
🔴 BREAK — serious harm or law demands, minimum to right authority
child abuse/neglect → DOVVSU + social welfare (MANDATORY, Act 560) • imminent violence → police + warned victim
notifiable disease → public health (TB, cholera, meningitis, AFP...) • court order → disclose as ordered, inform patient
unfit driver/pilot, impaired colleague endangering patients → regulator/employer • partner at HIV/STI risk → notification services
test: serious, imminent, identifiable harm only proper disclosure prevents? Yes → break, document, tell patient after.

svg.text: Practical locks: screens angled away, passwords never shared, folders closed + filed,
handovers out of earshot, phones on silent + clinical-use-only, no records home/photographed,
shred/confidential-waste, log-offs every exit. Breach drill: contain (retrieve/delete/lock) →
inform in-charge + data officer → assess harm → notify patient/regulator per policy → incident
form + learning. Snooping (colleague's/celebrity's/relative's file without care role) is
misconduct — audits log every access. Advocacy: the voiceless (child, unconscious,
mentally ill, prisoner, poor) get YOUR voice + safeguarding referrals + follow-up.
